redactions.reason: the provider's 429 envelope carries an account identifier. It is not the API key, it grants no access, and it is not evidence about the failure: it says who sent the request, not why it was rejected. This record is published, so the field is replaced rather than carried.
redactions.what_was_not_touched: every quantity the frozen delivery rule reads: status, timing, waits, request body digests, response digests, served provider and model, completion presence, model-execution evidence, outcomes and retry permissions. No measured value changed.
